column3: “To his face” is rendered “to meet him.” “By this is wrath on you” is rendered “and so bring wrath on yourself.”
“Good things have been found with you” is rendered “there is some good in you”; “Asherah poles” is rendered “Asheroth,” and “directed” as “set.”
“Returned and went out” is rendered “went out again.”
“For a city and a city” is rendered “city by city.”
NASB supplies “who is”; “in a matter of judgment” is rendered “when you render judgment.”
“Take care and act” is rendered “be very careful what you do.” “There is not with Yahweh” is rendered “will have no part in,” and “lifting up of face” as “partiality.”
The Hebrew ends “and they returned to Jerusalem”; NASB reads “among the inhabitants of Jerusalem,” as the ancient versions do. NASB supplies “to judge.”
“In faithfulness and with a complete heart” is rendered “faithfully and wholeheartedly.”
NASB supplies “that they may” and “may not come.”
“The priest of the head” is rendered “the chief priest,” and “to every matter of” as “in all that pertains to.” “Be strong and act” is rendered “Act resolutely,” and “the good” as “the upright.”
